Name: happiness_and_unhappiness_in_east_and_west_in_llms
Title: Happiness and Unhappiness in LLMs: Comparing LLM personas in Japan and the US.
Experiment: In this experiment, we try to reproduce the landmark psychology study 'happiness and unhappiness in east and west themes and variatios' by Uchida and Kitayama, but using LLM in different languages instead of real people. We survey LLM personas in 2 languages. The goal is to compare themes in the 2 languages, and producing a MDS analysis like the original paper to contrast the LLM personas in the 2 different languages.
